items.title: Zcash Drops 21% From Recent High—Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over
items.summary: ZEC is 21% off its $1,698 peak after ETF outflows and a suspected North Korean heist routed money through its shielded pool.

items.title: Evernorth clears shareholder vote ahead of Nasdaq debut with 473M XRP treasury
items.summary: Evernorth expects to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN after its SPAC merger closes, with an XRP treasury worth roughly $710 million at current prices.

items.title: SEC proposes framework allowing investment advisers, funds to self-custody crypto
items.summary: SEC proposed a crypto framework for investment advisers & funds, allowing self-custody in some cases & state trust companies as custodians.

items.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds
items.summary: The regulator issued a proposed rule for custody, marking a swan song for its inaugural Crypto Task Force chief, Commissioner Hester Peirce, who exits this week.
